description: Actions for an element that open as a context menu on right click, or an action sheet on long press on mobile.
overview:
`ContextActions` attaches a set of actions to an area of the page. On desktop it renders a `ContextMenu` that opens at the pointer on right click. Below the `48rem` breakpoint it renders an `AlertSheet` instead, opened by a 500 ms long press on touch, by the context menu event, or by the `ContextMenu` key or `Shift+F10`; the sheet groups the items in a card and appends a Cancel button.

Use it for secondary actions on content such as photos, files or list rows, where actions should stay out of the way until requested.
usage: Wrap the target area in `ContextActionsTrigger` and list the actions in `ContextActionsContent`. The open state is internal; use `onOpenChange` to react to it. A long press is cancelled if the finger moves more than 10 pixels, so scrolling over the trigger does not open the sheet.

examples.WithIcons: Places an icon before every action, including a destructive Delete item.
examples.NotDismissible: Sets `dismissible` to `false` so the mobile sheet closes only through an action or Cancel.

parts.ContextActions: The root that renders a `ContextMenu` on desktop and an `AlertSheet` on mobile.
parts.ContextActionsTrigger: The area that opens the actions on right click, or on long press and keyboard on mobile.
parts.ContextActionsContent: The popup holding the actions; on mobile it adds a Cancel button below them.
parts.ContextActionsLabel: A non-interactive heading; a menu label on desktop and the sheet title on mobile.
parts.ContextActionsItem: An actionable entry that closes the actions when chosen.
parts.ContextActionsSeparator: A divider between groups of items, rendered on desktop only.

ContextActions.onOpenChange: Called when the menu or sheet opens or closes.
ContextActions.dismissible: When `true`, the mobile sheet closes on an outside press; when `false`, it uses an alert dialog that closes only through an action or Cancel.

ContextActionsContent.cancelLabel: Text of the Cancel button shown below the actions on mobile.

ContextActionsItem.variant: Use `destructive` to style the item as a destructive action.
ContextActionsItem.disabled: Prevents the item from being chosen.

accessibility:
- On desktop the popup has the `menu` role and receives focus when opened; arrow keys move between `menuitem`s and `Enter` runs the focused one.
- `Escape` closes the menu.
- On mobile the trigger has `role="button"`, `tabIndex={0}` and `aria-haspopup="dialog"`, and opens with the `ContextMenu` key or `Shift+F10`.
notes: Parts carry `data-slot` values `context-actions`, `context-actions-trigger`, `context-actions-content`, `context-actions-label`, `context-actions-item` and `context-actions-separator`. On mobile the trigger disables text selection and the iOS touch callout so a long press does not select text.
